description.value: The study investigated inhibitory impairment and its neural basis in bvFTD, AD, ALS, and healthy controls using cognitive inhibition tests and FDG-PET brain metabolism.

spans.text: We investigated the inhibitory impairment and its neural basis using four different tests

description.value: This was a cross-sectional observational study of four groups: bvFTD, AD, ALS, and healthy controls.
